title: Focus day 22-02-15 - SonarQube
content:
Attendees:

We tested SonarQube, using our portfolio https://sonarqube.platform.iig.systems/portfolio?id=IPEX-DevOps-portfolio, and included configuration in our repositories

inter-ikea/cbf-re-ipex-devops-default-cicd (github.com)

inter-ikea/cbf-re-ipex-devops-spa-app (github.com)

Easy to get started via Knowledge Base article from Platform team.

Things to follow up on.

Platform team will follow up on revoke of tokens for users that are offboarded in Azure AD.

Look into approach for sharing SonarQube data for all IPEX teams

It is possible to create additional quality gates together with Platforms team.
